close_reason: Triage is complete: every live failure has a focused owning ticket, migration closeout work is directly under fz-9i4, and unrelated compiler epics no longer block this node.
description:
Goal

Classify failures exposed when the migrated fixtures2 corpus first ran honestly across compiler2 frontdoors. Reproduce each distinct failure, group only defects with a proven common root, and transfer live work to the compiler subsystem that owns the first incorrect fact.

Completed result

The original 119-failure observation was a migration-time census, not one compiler defect. Its buckets were either fixed by the closed children or split into focused tickets. The remaining live issues are now owned outside this triage node:

- Callable-boundary cleanup and the Enum.with_index mapper-demand defect are children of fz-k22.
- Impossible resource field access is a standalone semantic-diagnostic defect.
- Protocol, shared Enum.reduce, branch-wide matrix, and diagnostic-warning work remains with fz-bv3, fz-f98, fz-go4.22, and fz-lfp.
- The former cross-call Enum list-helper ABI defect is satisfied by fz-k22.21.
- Coverage-floor restoration moved directly under fz-9i4 because it is migration scaffolding removal.

Completion boundary

This ticket owns classification, not perpetual matrix health. Every reproduced live defect has a focused owner and acceptance signal; external compiler epics no longer block fixture migration.

comments.text:
Re-triaged the broad matrix red on fz-go4.1/frontdoor-cli-ownership; down to 64 fixture-matrix failures. Bucketed by cause (each maps to an existing ticket except the last):

- 17x 'unresolved multi-target direct callsite; dispatch must be settled upstream' (membership_operator, map_enumerable, range_enumerable, enumerable_protocol_dispatch, enum_take_drop_split, ...) — dispatch not settled. Same-arity tuple slice is fz-9i4.5.
- 5x 'matched multiple published boundaries' + 2x 'verify main' — callable boundary materialization; overlaps fz-hwn.13.
- 5x 'lower/unbound' (keyword_lists, ...).
- 4x 'ReturnLanes arity mismatch' (no_parens_do, no_parens_keyword, map_enumerable AOT).
- ~5x drive-limit / 3s timeouts (enum_tier0, enum_map_family) — overlaps fz-hwn.9.
- Golden-only / allocation-contract mismatches: see fz-rh2.16.2 (append/filter/reverse/quicksort now resolved there).

UNCOVERED bucket needing a dedicated ticket:
- 3x spec_violation 'expected diagnostic (nonzero exit) but the program succeeded', plus tree losing type/no-matching-clause and case_tuple_pattern_sequential losing case_clause fall-through. These are LOST exhaustiveness/spec diagnostics — a regression of the closed fz-rh2.11.8. Verified pre-existing vs parent commit ca703c6b7 (independent of the cons-reuse work). No open ticket covers this; recommend filing one.

title: Classify and split failures exposed by the unified fixtures2 matrix
